description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Use when an agent asks what just launched on pump.fun, which coins are about to graduate, or what graduated to PumpSwap. Mint, symbol, creator, age, bonding-curve progress, SOL in curve. Returns JSON pump.fun rows: mint, symbol, creator, age, bonding-curve progress, and SOL in the curve.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

kind.description: Which pump.fun slice to return. Format: one of the allowed values. Example: launches. Allowed values: launches, near-graduation, graduations.

limit.description: Maximum tokens. Format: positive integer. Example: 20. Omit for the server's current cap.

min_progress.description: Minimum bonding-curve progress. Format: a number, used with near-graduation. Example: 80. Omit for every progress level.

name: pumpfun_feed
title: Pump.fun launches and graduations ($0.005)
